options.content:
What the agent consumed, per model, and whether the context is under pressure

Tokens are reported as tokens. Where a model has a list price in the price table, the page also prices them — as list price, which is a cost only under per-token billing. The per-model split is the point: an aggregate hides a model that costs five times another for the same work. Context pressure — compaction and cache — is the part of cost a team can act on this week.

panels.title: Total tokens

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.input_tokens + s.output_tokens
       + COALESCE(s.cache_read_tokens,0) + COALESCE(s.cache_write_tokens,0)), 0) AS v
FROM whodunit_sessions s
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
WHERE s.first_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND  s.input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')

panels.description:
Every token billed: uncached input + cache reads + cache writes + output.

**Almost all of it is cache reads.** Measured here: 7.53B cache reads, 54.6M cache writes, 13.2M uncached input, 7.9M output — so this number tracks how much context was re-sent, not how much the models produced. The four tiles to the right hold the same breakdown as live figures.

Tokens, not currency: under a subscription the marginal cost of a token is zero, so a price table would report money nobody spent. Multiply by your own contract if you need a figure.

panels.title: Output tokens

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.output_tokens), 0) AS v
FROM whodunit_sessions s
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
WHERE s.first_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND  s.output_tokens IS NOT NULL AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')

panels.description:
What the models actually produced, as opposed to what was re-sent to them.

Typically a fraction of a percent of the total — 0.1% measured here.

**Total and Output are three orders of magnitude apart**, so they render in different units (B against M) and comparing them by eye reads as a contradiction. They are not: 7.6 B is a thousand times 7.6 M.

panels.title: Uncached input

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.input_tokens), 0) AS v
FROM whodunit_sessions s
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
WHERE s.first_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND  s.input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')

panels.description:
Input the model had to read fresh, at full price.

This is the figure a cache is meant to shrink. It was missing from this dashboard entirely, which left the headline total — almost all of it cache reads — looking like the whole story.

panels.title: Cache reads

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.cache_read_tokens), 0) AS v
FROM whodunit_sessions s
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
WHERE s.first_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND  s.cache_read_tokens IS NOT NULL AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')

panels.description:
Context re-sent and served from cache at about a tenth of base rate.

Normally the largest number on this dashboard by three orders of magnitude — 99% of the total here — which is why the headline figure is not a measure of how much work was produced.

panels.title: Served from cache

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(s.cache_read_tokens,0))
  / NULLIF(SUM(s.input_tokens + COALESCE(s.cache_read_tokens,0)
             + COALESCE(s.cache_write_tokens,0)), 0), 1) AS v
FROM whodunit_sessions s
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
WHERE s.first_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND  s.input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')

panels.description:
Share of input tokens served from cache.

**Cache writes count as uncached here**, because a write arrives uncached and is billed above base rate. Omitting them turns a real 48% into a flattering 99% — measured on this project's own data.

panels.title: Cache write payback

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(s.cache_read_tokens,0))
  / NULLIF(SUM(s.cache_write_tokens), 0), 2) AS v
FROM whodunit_sessions s
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
WHERE s.first_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND  s.cache_write_tokens IS NOT NULL AND s.cache_write_tokens > 0 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')

panels.description:
Reads returned per token written to cache — a **ratio, not a percentage**. 135 means each cached token was read back 135 times.

Below 1.25x the writes cost more than they saved — a write is billed at about 1.25x base and a read at 0.1x.

**The obvious break-even of 1.0 is wrong**: a series at 1.10x lost money while looking healthy.

Empty for Codex, which reports cache reads but never writes.

panels.title: List-price spend per model, per week
panels.description: Each week's tokens priced at each model's own list price, stacked by model. The shape to watch is a model climbing that costs more per token than the one it displaced. Models with no price row are absent, not zero; see the Investment Case for the price list.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(s.last_seen/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(s.last_seen/1e9)) DAY) AS DATETIME) AS time,
       s.model AS metric, ROUND(SUM((COALESCE(s.input_tokens,0)/1e6*p.input_usd + COALESCE(s.output_tokens,0)/1e6*p.output_usd + COALESCE(s.cache_read_tokens,0)/1e6*p.cache_read_usd + COALESCE(s.cache_write_tokens,0)/1e6*p.cache_write_usd)),2) AS value
FROM whodunit_sessions s LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) LEFT JOIN whodunit_model_prices p ON p.model = s.model WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND s.input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND p.model IS NOT NULL AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
GROUP BY time, s.model ORDER BY time, s.model

panels.title: Cost per thousand agent-written lines, by model
panels.description: List-price spend per model against the lines that model's events added, and output tokens per line. This is the efficiency figure per model: a model that costs more per token can still cost less per line if it needs fewer tokens to get there. Lines are attributed by the model on the event.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sp AS (SELECT s.model, SUM((COALESCE(s.input_tokens,0)/1e6*p.input_usd + COALESCE(s.output_tokens,0)/1e6*p.output_usd + COALESCE(s.cache_read_tokens,0)/1e6*p.cache_read_usd + COALESCE(s.cache_write_tokens,0)/1e6*p.cache_write_usd)) usd, SUM(s.output_tokens) out_tok FROM whodunit_sessions s LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) LEFT JOIN whodunit_model_prices p ON p.model = s.model
            WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND s.input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND p.model IS NOT NULL AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}') GROUP BY s.model),
ln AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(e.model,''),'(no model)') model, SUM(e.lines_added) added
       FROM whodunit_events e LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
       WHERE e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND e.lines_added > 0
         AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
         AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
       GROUP BY model)
SELECT sp.model AS `Model`, ROUND(sp.usd,2) AS `List-price spend`, ln.added AS `Lines the agent wrote`,
       ROUND(sp.usd/NULLIF(ln.added/1000,0),2) AS `$ per 1,000 agent lines`,
       ROUND(sp.out_tok/NULLIF(ln.added,0),0) AS `Output tokens per line`
FROM sp LEFT JOIN ln ON ln.model = sp.model ORDER BY sp.usd DESC

panels.title: Context pressure — the part you can act on
Compaction and cache, per week
panels.description: Share of sessions that compacted at least once, and share of input served from cache, per week. Compaction rising with cache falling is sessions outgrowing their context; both rising is long sessions that are at least being served cheaply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(s.last_seen/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(s.last_seen/1e9)) DAY) AS DATETIME) AS time,
       ROUND(100*SUM(s.compactions > 0)/COUNT(*),0) AS `Sessions that compacted`,
       ROUND(100*SUM(COALESCE(s.cache_read_tokens,0))/NULLIF(SUM(s.input_tokens + COALESCE(s.cache_read_tokens,0)),0),0) AS `Input served from cache`
FROM whodunit_sessions s LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) LEFT JOIN whodunit_model_prices p ON p.model = s.model WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND s.compactions IS NOT NULL AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
GROUP BY time HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY time

panels.title: What a compacted session looks like
panels.description: Sessions that compacted against those that did not: average output tokens, tool calls and context tokens. Compacted sessions being much larger on every axis is expected — they are the long ones. What to look for is output not keeping pace with context: paying for a large window and getting little out of it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN s.compactions > 0 THEN 'Compacted' ELSE 'Did not compact' END AS metric,
       ROUND(AVG(s.output_tokens)) AS `Output tokens`, ROUND(AVG(s.tool_calls),1) AS `Tool calls`,
       ROUND(AVG(s.input_tokens + COALESCE(s.cache_read_tokens,0))) AS `Context tokens`, COUNT(*) AS `Sessions`
FROM whodunit_sessions s LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) LEFT JOIN whodunit_model_prices p ON p.model = s.model WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND s.compactions IS NOT NULL AND s.output_tokens IS NOT NULL AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
GROUP BY metric ORDER BY metric

panels.title: Output tokens per assisted commit, per week
panels.description: Output tokens that week divided by assisted commits that week. The tokens-per-unit-of-output trend: falling is the team getting more commit per token, rising is longer conversations for the same output. Weekly, so one big session can move it.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(s.last_seen/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(s.last_seen/1e9)) DAY) wk, SUM(s.output_tokens) out_tok
  FROM whodunit_sessions s LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) LEFT JOIN whodunit_model_prices p ON p.model = s.model WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND s.output_tokens IS NOT NULL AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}') GROUP BY wk),
c AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) DAY) wk, COUNT(*) n
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status='assisted' AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}') GROUP BY wk)
SELECT CAST(w.wk AS DATETIME) AS time, ROUND(w.out_tok/NULLIF(c.n,0)) AS `Output tokens per assisted commit`
FROM w JOIN c ON c.wk = w.wk ORDER BY time

panels.title: Token use and cache efficiency by model

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(s.model, ''), '(unattributed)') AS Model,
  COUNT(*)                                        AS Sessions,
  SUM(s.input_tokens)                             AS `Uncached in`,
  SUM(s.output_tokens)                            AS `Out`,
  SUM(COALESCE(s.cache_read_tokens,0))            AS `Cache read`,
  SUM(COALESCE(s.cache_write_tokens,0))           AS `Cache write`,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(s.cache_read_tokens,0))
    / NULLIF(SUM(s.input_tokens + COALESCE(s.cache_read_tokens,0)
               + COALESCE(s.cache_write_tokens,0)), 0), 1) AS `From cache %`,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(s.cache_read_tokens,0))
    / NULLIF(SUM(s.cache_write_tokens), 0), 1)    AS `Write payback ×`
FROM whodunit_sessions s
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
WHERE s.first_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND  s.input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(s.model, ''), '(unattributed)')
ORDER BY SUM(s.input_tokens + s.output_tokens
           + COALESCE(s.cache_read_tokens,0)
           + COALESCE(s.cache_write_tokens,0)) DESC

panels.description:
**Per model, because the aggregate hides the finding.** An overall 48% read ratio measured on real data contained one model at 0.73x amortisation — a loss, invisible in the total.

`Write payback` below 1.25x is red: those writes cost more than they saved. Empty means the agent does not report cache writes rather than that it wrote none.

panels.title: Reasoning effort

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.effort AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM whodunit_sessions s
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
WHERE s.first_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND  s.effort IS NOT NULL AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY s.effort

defaults.noValue: no session recorded an effort tier

panels.description:
How hard the model was asked to think, where the agent says.

The lever behind the token counts above: a higher tier spends more on the same task.

panels.title: Human edited the agent's output

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN e.user_modified = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS v
FROM whodunit_events e
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
WHERE e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND  e.user_modified IS NOT NULL AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')

panels.description:
Share of edits a human changed before committing — the difference between 'the agent wrote this' and 'the agent wrote this and it was kept'.

Claude Code alone reports it. The denominator counts only calls that carried the signal, so agents without it do not dilute the rate.

options.content: Read with care. Under a subscription the marginal token costs nothing and every dollar here is notional. Agents that report no tokens are absent from every figure, not free. Lines the agent wrote are attributed by the model on the event; sessions and events are joined by model, not by session, so a model used in both counts once each side. Compaction is a symptom of long sessions, not a fault.
